verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents the official Windows App SDK with a WinUI 3 quickstart, guidance for adding it to existing projects and migrating from UWP, and supported languages (C#/.NET, C++/WinRT, Rust via windows-rs). It also offers Windows AI APIs and the AI Foundry toolkit, which suit AI-native builders. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs, and detailed API reference depth for the AI APIs (the evidence is mostly doc page titles).
